name: Amamiya Mei
source:
Mei’s metal band is still just an indie act, but they’re amazingly famous among those in the know. Excessive headbanging has left her with a neck injury that, according to doctors, could even endanger her life! Still, she can’t stop giving her all to the music. She visits Relaxation Yubihara to have her neck fixed. While she’s usually withdrawn and awkward, get her excited and her personality makes a 180 and she goes on the attack!

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/games/beat-refle]Gematsu[/url]]
